body:
**Re: DGov Chain**
Think this is very dope. Jam and Elliot Tissoniere (sp)  had raised a similar idea and while it kind of centralizes an attack vector against many chains - I think it has merit in the same way Commonwealth.im works to allow users to manage several chains effectively.

**Re: Multichain community**
Yep. Total alignment. We're currently working to explore a community merger with Straightedge that would result in Edgeware Cosmos - and I think our concept is that relying on one technology isn't necessary, if we can coordinate resources and decisions effectively, we can also leverage multiple platforms.  I also appreciate the co-chain staking towards new chains on EDG. 
- See my post: [Multi-chain Edgeware](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1095-multichain-edgeware-a-new-path-to-dot)


**Re: Talent Journey**
This is a great way of thinking - token engineering and funding/infrastructure support are the best ways I can imagine keeping talent aligned to a degree, while also allowing the natural process for highly skilled developers to grow into their own.  I think this can be part of a wider developer incentive concept, and will open a thread. 

Also - pioneer is a great case study. I went through it myself several times!
